description: Observed after #5/db87cef: on 200k-class models, OM's session_before_compact custom CompactionResult replaces Pi's real summarizer with an OM snapshot while before_agent_start injects the same snapshot again. Combined summary + injected OM + retained tail can immediately recross Pi's compaction threshold and loop. Assess against current Pi compaction lifecycle, then if confirmed: force-observe/publish in session_before_compact but return undefined; remove custom OM CompactionResult machinery; clamp stage/publish/reflection thresholds down to the active model window without raising user-configured values; cap injected published OM to a bounded share of the active window; update focused regressions/docs/version; validate lint, tests, and typecheck. Observer auth behavior is explicitly out of scope.
title: Stop OM compaction loops on 200k-class models
